theme.rationale: High-intensity dialer command center operations requiring sustained 8+ hour monitoring without ocular fatigue. Deep slate obsidian base with precise signal highlights.

typography.font_family_headings: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

hierarchy.kpi_value: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-mono font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-50

layout_architecture.type: Full Desktop Operations Control Center with Collapsible AI Intelligence Drawer

navigation.top_bar: h-14 border-b border-[#1F2B45] bg-[#0E131F]/95 backdrop-blur-md px-6 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-40

layout_architecture.grid_structure: Grid Mode B: High Density Command Layout with 1px border division (no heavy dropshadows, crisp technical borders)
layout_architecture.ai_side_panel: Fixed 400px width slide-out right drawer (expandable to 500px), with streaming message simulator, fast prompt chips, and real-time operational context binding.

charts.description: Area + Line dual chart showing Hourly Connect Rate % vs Dials made
Bar chart comparing inbound calls handled vs outbound campaign connection efficiency
7-day by 24-hour heat matrix of connect probability with instant Primo dialler scheduling suggestions

steps: 1. Drag & drop CDR / Lead Export (CSV or Excel)
2. Automated Column Mapping (Phone, CLI, Disposition, Duration, Timestamp, List ID)
csv_upload_wizard.upload_history_table: List past uploads with batch status, row counts, and error validation

sections: Active Operational Rules (e.g. 'Never dial Nevada lead lists after 7 PM EST')
Learned Outcomes & Weights (Adjusted confidence based on feedback)
Operator Manual Directives (Custom notes given to the AI assistant)

interactive_rules.testing_attributes: All clickable buttons, tabs, modal triggers, and inputs MUST include data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='upload-csv-btn', data-testid='apply-rec-btn-1', data-testid='ai-chat-send-btn').
interactive_rules.sonner_toast: Use Sonner for feedback when: AI recommendation is applied, CLI rotated, file uploaded, or memory rule saved.
interactive_rules.modals_and_drawers: Use solid background with subtle 1px border (#1F2B45) and backdrop blur overlay (never transparent backgrounds).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.styling_discipline: High-density dark command center. Do not use generic full-screen gradients. Use crisp 1px borders (#1F2B45) with #0E131F card surfaces.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_contrast: Numbers and metric figures must be rendered in tabular font-mono for scanning speed. Status badges must have explicit contrasting text and slight desaturated backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.ai_personality: Pragmatic, high-precision dialer supervisor named 'Primo Sentinel AI'. Direct, actionable telemetry insights instead of generic chat answers.
